root_cause: Delivered order has 3 billed items (R$ 143.46) but zero payment record in the payment gateway table.
Payment was collected on an active/shipped order, but the billing table (order_items) has zero items recorded.
Billing table copied item price into the delivery fee column (freight_value == price) across 3 sellers, falsely doubling the item price.
Delivered order where a 5% debit-card, 10% promo, flat R$10, or bundle discount was applied at payment without being logged in the billing or voucher table.
Single-installment (1x) delivered order where the payment gateway collected slightly more than the billed price + delivery fee.
Canceled or out-of-stock (unavailable) order with customer payment collected and zero invoice items; payment table lacks a refund status column.
Canceled or out-of-stock (unavailable) order with both invoice items and customer payment collected; payment table lacks a refund status column.
Invoice and payment amounts match 100%, but order has a missing approval/delivery date, backwards carrier-to-customer timestamp, or 0-installment retry flag.
Multi-installment (>1x) credit-card order where extra amount collected above base invoice represents buyer installment financing interest.
Minor 1-to-6 cent rounding difference between item sum and installment/split payment sum.
Canceled order where customer abandoned checkout with R$ 0.00 paid (and 0 invoice items).
Order system, billing table, and payment gateway match with zero financial or timestamp defects.
